name: handoff
description: Hands off in place, never with /clear: at every crossing of the threshold (the fill read as the app reads it, against the compaction window) the mod compacts the session with the handoff's sections; every compaction of a person's session keeps them and leaves its summary as a handoff file. No Jev, no paid calls.

threshold.description: Fallback threshold: context fill (percent of the compaction window, as the app shows it) at which the session is compacted in place after the turn ends, at every crossing; handoff_threshold_pct of the project's budgets.json wins.
threshold.title: Auto-handoff threshold (%)

handoffDir.description: Directory for handoff files, relative to the project root (e.g. `claude` for a team-lead repo).
handoffDir.title: Handoff directory

autoCompact.description: Past the threshold, compact the session in place with the handoff's sections (the task list, background work and the session stay); off writes the handoff file only. The context is never cleared.
autoCompact.title: Compact in place at the handoff

minTurns.description: Never hand off automatically before this many user prompts in the session.
minTurns.title: Minimum prompts before auto-handoff

language.description: Language of the handoff document and of the compaction's instructions.
language.title: Language
